name: astute-chat-ollama
description: Private, offline-first AI chat and agent for VS Code, powered by your own Ollama server.

astuteChat.server.host.patternErrorMessage: Enter an IP address or hostname, without http:// or a port.
astuteChat.server.host.markdownDescription: IP address or hostname of the Ollama server. This can only be set per machine, so a workspace cannot redirect your prompts.

astuteChat.server.https.markdownDescription: Connect to the Ollama server over HTTPS. Use this when the server is behind a TLS proxy.

astuteChat.serverUrl.description: Deprecated. Base URL of the Ollama server.

astuteChat.model.markdownDescription: Ollama model to use. Leave empty to use the smallest local model.

astuteChat.agentModel.markdownDescription: Model for Agent mode. Leave empty to use `#astuteChat.model#`. If that model can't use tools, Agent picks one that can.

astuteChat.visionModel.markdownDescription: Model that reads images when the chat model can't. Leave empty to use the smallest local model with vision.

astuteChat.numCtx.markdownDescription: Context window in tokens. This is capped to the limit of the selected model. Larger values use more memory.

astuteChat.numThread.markdownDescription: CPU threads for a local Ollama server. `0` chooses automatically: two thirds of the cores on CPUs with 12 or more cores, otherwise the Ollama default. Using every core can make large CPUs several times slower.

astuteChat.keepAlive.markdownDescription: How long Ollama keeps the model loaded after a response, such as `30m`, `2h` or `0`.

astuteChat.idleTimeoutSeconds.description: Stop waiting if the server sends nothing for this long.

astuteChat.thinking.description: Ask models that support thinking to show their reasoning.

astuteChat.tools.enabled.description: Let models that support tools use workspace tools in trusted workspaces. Ask and Plan can only read. Agent can also change files and run commands, subject to your approvals.

astuteChat.vectorTheme.enabled.markdownDescription: Apply the Astute Vector look to all of VS Code: the colour theme, Astute Vector Mono at size 13 in the terminal, and Courier Prime in the editor. Turning this off restores your previous theme and fonts. Fonts must be installed on your computer. Run **Astute Code: Install Astute Vector Mono Font** for the terminal font.

astuteChat.web.enabled.markdownDescription: Let models read web pages, in every mode. Each request asks first, except in full Auto. Search queries go to DuckDuckGo, or your own search server if you set one, and addresses are contacted directly. This can only be set per machine, so a workspace can't turn it on.

astuteChat.web.searchUrl.patternErrorMessage: Enter a full address, such as http://127.0.0.1:8888.
astuteChat.web.searchUrl.markdownDescription: Address of a [SearXNG](https://docs.searxng.org) server with JSON results turned on. Leave this empty to search with DuckDuckGo.

astuteChat.web.allowPrivateAddresses.markdownDescription: Let models open addresses on this computer and your private network, such as an intranet. Leave this off unless you need it, because a web page could point a model at internal services.

astuteChat.mcp.servers.markdownDescription: MCP servers that Agent can use, as `{ "name": { "command": "...", "args": [] } }`. These run as programs on your machine, so add only servers you trust. This can only be set per machine, so a workspace can't add a server.

astuteChat.languageSkills.markdownDescription: Experimental. Add built-in C, C++ and Python guidance when the request, open file or project uses that language. In testing this did not improve results, so it is off by default. A workspace skill named `c`, `cpp` or `python` replaces the built-in one.

astuteChat.approvals.allowedCommands.markdownDescription: Extra command prefixes that **Safe auto** can approve, such as `npm test`. These commands run project code, so add only ones you trust. Commands that use redirects or substitution still ask.

astuteChat.debugSkills.description: Include the full text of every skill in the system prompt.

chatParticipants.name: astute
chatParticipants.description: Ask your Ollama model about this workspace

commands.name: help
commands.description: List the available skills and usage tips.

colors.description: Astute accent colour used for emphasis and active states.
Soft Astute highlight used in subtle border and background treatments.
Dark base tone for Astute surfaces.

scripts.compile: npm run typecheck && npm run build

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Workspace skills and file tools are disabled until the workspace is trusted.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Skills and file tools need a local or remote file system.
